lines.text: A prophet's sign comes about, but he urges worship of other gods, so Israel must not listen, for the LORD is testing them.
Israel must hold fast to the LORD, and that prophet must die for urging rebellion against the God who brought them out of Babylon.
If a brother, son, daughter, wife or closest friend secretly entices them toward other gods, they must show no pity.
Israel must stone the one who enticed them, and then all Israel will hear and be proud.
After a thorough investigation, a city led astray must be burned with its plunder and remain a mound of ruins forever.
